Six-joint arm, pick and place

Six links on SO(3) and six motor rotors (scalar spins), 24 coordinates, with a 1 kg payload. geomech derives the unconstrained equations; the six hinges and six gears are 18 constraint rows that the prototype solves with the equations (KKT) and projects onto every 10 ms, leaving 6 DOF. PD control with gravity compensation through the gears moves the arm through a pick-and-place sequence. The 'Energy change' figure is the work of the motors. Prototype built with geomech; not part of geomech.systems.
